name: Life spaceship bf101de9 on 3-uniform tiling k3-044
description: A period-31 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 3-uniform tiling k3-044, with touching neighbours, 3 to 18 cells, moving two lattice steps every 31 generations (2c/31). It runs the same way in the 131,072 rules from B3/S23 to B3,9,10,11,12,13,14,15,16/S2,3,9,10,11,12,13,14,15,16. JETCARP's Life census met it in 42,183 of its 50,000 soups on this tiling.
